semanticAssessment: The class ran from a cleanTest (29 tests discovered, 0 errors, 0 skipped, 28 passed, all existing tests unedited and green). The target executed sendOrderConfirmation through the real service against the mocked JavaMailSender, reparsed the sent message and failed on its planned no-double-full-stop assertion for status [received]: the body quoted in the report contains "Peckham Jollof Co.." twice, in the lead and in the sent-on-behalf-of footer. The remaining text (seller block, allergen record, cancellation statement, platform line "company number 16471464.") has no other double full stop, so the failure is G-37-6 defect 2 alone, not platform text. Not a compile, setup or fixture fault.
